quotes.summary_phrase: Mikal Bridges on his dietary evolution and focus on protein
quotes.excerpt: I'm a big French fry guy. Making sure I'm staying locked in on my protein and my carbs.
quotes.quote: My diet changed over time just canceling out food like fried food. I'm a big French fry guy. Making sure I'm staying locked in on my protein and my carbs and stuff like that.

quotes.speaker: Mikal Bridges
quotes.summary_phrase: Mikal Bridges on the struggle of overeating to gain weight
quotes.excerpt: What's always a tough struggle for me is overeating to put on weight.
quotes.quote: What's always a tough struggle for me is overeating to put on weight. I love to eat, but stuffing myself is always difficult. There be days where I'm not that hungry right now, but I try to eat every three hours. Sometimes I get sleepy, I get tired, I'm trying to do things, it's just tough for me.

quotes.speaker: Mikal Bridges
quotes.summary_phrase: Mikal Bridges on his pizza cheat day habit
quotes.excerpt: My cheat day, low-key, has been pizza. I know I'm lactose, but my stomach tells myself I'm strong.
quotes.quote: My cheat day, low-key, has been pizza. I know I'm lactose, but my stomach tells myself I'm strong and I'll be okay, so I'll say pizza.
